hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC offering/prospectus filings that are normally dilution-overhang negative may become positive when the signal-day price action absorbs the financing shock versus SPY, indicating institutional demand and validated capital use before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

prediction.confidence_reason: This is a materially distinct SEC submissions event source rather than a Companyfacts ratio or generic SEC contract text. Prior SEC contract parsing explicitly excluded underwriting/common-stock/ATM/offering text, and supply-overhang absorption variants show the mechanism can matter, but financing events may simply be dilution noise after next-open execution and accepted comparators.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC submissions cache, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT SEC offering-form events, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC offering price-absorption source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: aggregate_ev_not_positive, aggregate_pnl_not_positive, window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested issuer offering/prospectus forms plus signal-day SPY-relative price absorption. The result is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta -0.2291; aggregate PnL delta $-6,133.11; max drawdown drift +0.0016; 102 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping offering form lists, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: If this fixed offering-absorption bundle fails, do not retry by sweeping offering form lists, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows. A valid retry needs materially richer PIT financing economics such as offering amount normalized by market cap, use-of-proceeds, debt vs equity classification, ATM drawdown amounts, or closed forward replacement-value rows.
